class.name: SkeletonDefinition
class.brief_description: A named bone hierarchy and reference pose shared by 3D animation assets.
class.description: Stores bone names, parent indices and local rest transforms in a text [code].sk[/code] resource. Create one from [method Skeleton3D.create_skeleton_definition] or by importing a model. The skeleton's animations are the [code].skanim[/code] files below its animation directory, see [member animation_directory]. A clip file directly in that directory is an animation of the default library and its file name is the animation name. Each sub-directory is one more [AnimationLibrary] named after the directory, so [code]Sword/Slash.skanim[/code] plays as [code]"Sword/Slash"[/code]. Renaming or moving a clip file therefore renames the animation. The skeleton file itself lists no clips. An [AnimationPlayer] with [member AnimationPlayer.skeleton_definition] set exposes exactly these libraries.

method.name: bake_animation_libraries
method.description: Returns the current libraries as a [Dictionary] of library name to a new [AnimationLibrary] that references the same clips. The exporter stores this in [member animation_libraries].

method.name: compare
method.description: Compares bones by name, independently of their stored index order. Returns [code]compatible[/code], [code]hierarchy_matches[/code], [code]missing_bones[/code], [code]extra_bones[/code], [code]parent_mismatches[/code], and [code]rest_mismatches[/code]. Bone lists are [PackedStringArray] values relative to this definition. Empty definitions are incompatible. Compatibility requires identical names, parent relationships, and rest transforms within [param tolerance]. The tolerance is an absolute per-component difference for local position and Basis values. Scene root transforms and animation track paths are outside this comparison.

method.name: find_bone
method.description: Returns the named bone's index, or [code]-1[/code] if absent.

method.name: get_animation_catalog
method.description: Returns every animation, ordered by library and name. Each entry contains [code]name[/code] (the name passed to [method AnimationPlayer.play]), [code]library[/code], [code]animation[/code], [code]path[/code] and [code]uid[/code].

method.name: get_animation_directory_path
method.description: Returns the resolved path of the animation directory, or an empty string while the skeleton is not saved to a file.

method.name: get_animation_library
method.description: Returns the animation library named [param library]. The default library is the animation directory itself and always exists. Returns [code]null[/code] for a library that does not exist. The returned object is updated in place by [method rescan_animations]; add or remove animations by adding or removing clip files instead of editing it.

method.name: get_animation_library_names
method.description: Returns the names of all animation libraries in alphabetical order. The default library is the empty name.

method.name: get_animation_scan_issues
method.description: Returns the files below the animation directory that were not loaded as animations. Each entry contains [code]path[/code], [code]reason[/code] ([code]invalid_name[/code], [code]load_failed[/code], [code]foreign_skeleton[/code] or [code]nested_directory[/code]) and a readable [code]message[/code].

method.name: get_bone_name
method.description: Returns the bone name at [param index].

method.name: get_bone_parent
method.description: Returns the parent index, or [code]-1[/code] for a root bone.

method.name: has_baked_animation_libraries
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the skeleton uses the libraries stored in [member animation_libraries] instead of listing its animation directory. This is the case in exported projects and for skeleton files written before the animation directory existed.

method.name: rescan_animations
method.description: Lists the animation directory again and updates the libraries in place. Returns [code]true[/code] and emits [signal animations_changed] if anything changed. The editor calls this whenever the file system changes. Does nothing while [method has_baked_animation_libraries] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_bones
method.description: Replaces all bones atomically. Every dictionary must contain [code]name[/code] ([String] or [StringName]), [code]parent[/code] ([int]), and [code]rest[/code] ([Transform3D]). Returns [constant OK] on success or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] for duplicate or empty names, names containing [code]:[/code] or [code]/[/code], invalid parents, cycles, or non-finite transforms. The input dictionaries are copied. Parent indices may appear after their children.

members.member: The directory that holds this skeleton's clip files, relative to the skeleton file or as a [code]res://[/code] path. While empty, [code]<skeleton file name>_anims[/code] next to the skeleton is used, and that name is stored the first time the skeleton is saved.

Animation libraries stored in the file instead of being listed from [member animation_directory]. Written by the exporter so that an exported project needs no directory listing. Empty in a project's own skeleton files.
A read-only snapshot of the bone hierarchy and rest transforms. Use [method set_bones] to replace the complete definition.

Soft reference to the default [PackedScene] ([code].skmesh[/code]) used to preview animations. The scene must be a project [code].skmesh[/code] whose [AnimationPlayer] uses this skeleton. Resolved by UID when available. The preview model is loaded when opening the animation asset workspace.

signal.name: animations_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method rescan_animations] found added, removed, renamed or moved clip files.
